notes: Timing and memory measurements are separate rows.
Each measurement point loads PB1 model_config.yaml and best_model.pth freshly.
Five untimed warm-up forwards precede ten individually timed forwards by default.
Every timed forward is synchronised immediately before and after execution; the median individual latency is reported.
A short sleep between timed forwards is outside the measured interval; cleanup happens after each measurement point.
LaplaceNet is called directly without a precomputed X_s argument, so its forward method recomputes the input transformation on every invocation.
Forecast-step scaling uses a real long window from the scaled dataset and slices prefixes.
Sample-count scaling copies the same real window to isolate batch-size effects.
